findings.title: PWA manifest ships only an SVG icon and is duplicated across three sources
evidence: apps/web/app/manifest.ts:11-18 declares a single icon (favicon.svg, sizes any)
apps/web/public/manifest.json and apps/web/public/manifest.webmanifest are byte-identical duplicates of the same manifest
no 192x192/512x512 PNG or maskable icon is declared
findings.impact: Installability and home-screen appearance on Android/iOS are degraded, and three manifest sources can drift so the served manifest is ambiguous.
findings.recommendation: Keep one manifest source (the Next metadata route), add 192/512 PNG and maskable icons, and delete the duplicate public manifests.
